sentences.en: As to onomatopoetic expressions, we find interesting examples in Hopi.
sentences.zh: 关于拟声词，我们在霍皮语中找到了一些有趣的例子。

sentences.en: Insofar as possible, our examples will be drawn from English.
sentences.zh: 尽可能地，我们的例证将来自英语。

sentences.en: Could you please give me some more examples of that?
sentences.zh: 你能再给我举几个那样的例子吗？

senses.zh: 作为…的例子；为…做出榜样
